settings.question: Open Sole or Closed Sole — which one?
settings.answer: Both perform identically with the same grip and stability. The difference is feel and coverage. Open Sole: heel exposed, mid-foot breathing hole. More grounded, barefoot feel. Natural toe splay. Closed Sole: heel and foot fully covered. Choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: Are these good for reformer Pilates, Megaformer, Lagree & hot Pilates?
settings.answer: Yes — engineered for reformer carriage load, Megaformer, Lagree, barre, hot Pilates, and yoga. The 360° grip handles lateral forces that destroy traditional Pilates socks and yoga socks. Both perform identically with the same grip and stability.

settings.question: How long do they actually last?
settings.answer: Customers report 18+ months with daily studio use and zero grip degradation. The patented material doesn't wear down like silicone dots or rubber patches. One pair replaces 6–8 pairs of grip socks per year.

settings.question: How do I clean them?
settings.answer: Warm soapy water, rinse, air dry. Ready for your next class in under an hour. Never machine wash or bleach. How to put on: pull from the top of the foot — not the straps — to help extend their lifespan.

settings.question: What size should I order?
settings.answer: Available now: M (Women 5.5–7.5) and L (Women 7.5–11, Men up to 10.5). Between 7.5 and 8? Wider foot → Large. Narrower foot → Medium.

settings.question: Can I wear socks underneath?
settings.answer: Designed to work barefoot or with a sock. Barefoot: direct connection to the surface — most customers prefer this. Thin toeless or individual-toe sock: extra warmth or moisture control, still get full grip. Thin full sock: works for hot yoga (absorbs extra sweat) or studios requiring a sock.

settings.question: Grip shoes for Megaformer & Lagree fitness
settings.answer: Megaformer and Lagree demand lateral stability that grip socks cannot provide. Super Lunges, Catfish, and Bear on the Megaformer — locked-in grip through holds, transitions, and balance. Trusted by Lagree-certified instructors across North America.

settings.answer: Elephant, knee stretches, and pikes — the long stretch series demands 360° grip. Locked-in through reformer footwork — no adjusting between sets. Barefoot feel with natural toe splay.
